description: This file provides centralized configuration for the LMS frontend, reading environment variables with validation, parsing feature flags, and exposing utility functions for API URL construction.

methods.name: parseFeatureFlags
methods.description: Parses feature flags from environment variable, accepting JSON object, JSON array, or comma-separated string, returning a normalized object.

methods.name: getApiBase
methods.description: Returns the base URL for REST API calls, preferring REACT_APP_API_BASE then REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.

methods.name: apiUrl
methods.description: Builds a full API URL from a given path segment, ensuring proper slash handling.
